common: Would you rather always have to whisper or always have to shout?
Would you rather give up sweets or give up salty snacks?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late or 20 minutes early?
Would you rather only text in emojis or only text in full sentences?
Would you rather have a messy room or a messy inbox?
Would you rather lose your phone charger or your headphones?
Would you rather always take the stairs or always take the long way?
Would you rather have cold coffee or warm soda?
Would you rather always sit in traffic or always wait in line?
Would you rather only eat breakfast food or only eat dinner food?
Would you rather have an itchy sweater or tight shoes for a day?
Would you rather always lose the TV remote or always lose one sock?
uncommon: Would you rather have to sing every request out loud or dance every time you enter a room?
Would you rather have unlimited pizza but no more tacos, or unlimited tacos but no more pizza?
Would you rather be able to talk to animals but they're all sarcastic, or talk to plants but they're all overly polite?
Would you rather have to high-five everyone you meet or bow to everyone you meet?
Would you rather have a pet dragon the size of a cat or a pet cat the size of a dragon?
Would you rather always know when someone's lying or always be able to tell the future about small, unimportant things?
Would you rather have the ability to pause time but age normally while paused, or never age but never pause time?
Would you rather have to narrate your own life out loud or hear a laugh track after everything you say?
Would you rather be famous for something embarrassing or completely unknown forever?
Would you rather have permanently sticky hands or permanently slippery hands?
rare: Would you rather be able to breathe underwater or fly, but only 3 feet off the ground?
Would you rather have the power to freeze time for 10 seconds a day, or rewind 10 seconds once a day?
Would you rather live one day as a legendary hero or a lifetime as an unremarkable villager?
Would you rather have every meal taste amazing but be nutritionally empty, or every meal be nutritious but taste like cardboard?
Would you rather know the exact date of your death or never know how you'll die at all?
Would you rather be able to teleport anywhere but arrive completely soaked, or fly slowly but arrive perfectly dry?
Would you rather have unlimited money but never be able to spend it on yourself, or modest money you can spend freely?
Would you rather be the strongest person in the world but the slowest, or the fastest but the weakest?
Would you rather live in a world with no music or a world with no color?
epic: Would you rather be the last person on Earth or one of a billion clones of yourself?
Would you rather control fire but be terrified of it, or control water but be unable to swim?
Would you rather relive the same year of your life on a loop, remembering each time, or forget everything and start fresh every year?
Would you rather have the power to bring people back to life but lose a year of your own life each time, or never gain that power at all?
Would you rather be worshipped as a god by a small forgotten village, or be an ordinary citizen in a thriving kingdom?
Would you rather be able to hear everyone's thoughts but not control it, or have everyone hear yours?
Would you rather permanently trade places with your closest friend, or never see them again?
Would you rather have infinite wisdom but no one believes you, or be seen as wise despite having none?
legendary: Would you rather be the reason a kingdom rises to glory, or the reason it falls, and never know which until the end?
Would you rather have the power to reshape reality once, knowing it may unmake everything you love, or never have that power at all?
Would you rather be remembered for a thousand years as a myth, or forgotten in a decade but truly happy?
Would you rather carry the weight of infinite knowledge alone, or share ignorance with everyone you love?
Would you rather be able to save one person from any fate, once, or protect everyone from small misfortunes forever?
Would you rather rule a kingdom you never wanted, or wander free with nothing to your name?
divine: Would you rather hold the fate of the universe in your hands for one second, or never know it was ever in your hands at all?
Would you rather exist outside of time, watching everything and changing nothing, or live one mortal life fully and completely?
Would you rather be the last thought in every mind before the universe ends, or never have existed at all?
Would you rather know the true nature of reality and never be able to tell anyone, or live in blissful, permanent illusion?
Would you rather be the answer to every question that will ever be asked, or the question no one will ever think to ask?
